No screen or functionality shown. No video or screenshot of the phone in use. Only physical photos provided.

risks.risk: Phone may not be functional or may have software issues
risks.proof: Video or screenshot showing the phone turned on, home screen, and basic functions (camera, calls, internet).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or with major defects.

risks.risk: Screen may have damage or dead pixels not visible in photos
risks.proof: Photo of the front screen turned on, showing full display with no cracks, discoloration, or dead pixels.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as screen may be damaged or graded C (as per sticker).

risks.risk: Battery health may be worse than stated (88% on sticker) or degraded in real use

risks.risk: Phone may be stolen, blacklisted, or have network lock issues

risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially blacklisted or locked, reducing value significantly.

proof_requests: Video or screenshot showing the phone turned on and functioning (home screen, camera, calls).
Photo of the front screen turned on, showing no damage or dead pixels.
Screenshot of IMEI check confirming no blacklisting or network lock.
Proof of warranty (if any) or receipt of purchase.
response.reason: The phone's identity is confirmed as a Samsung Galaxy S21 5G from the sticker. However, critical claims like 'working perfectly' and 'very clean' are unverified, and risks like functionality, screen condition, battery health, and blacklisting cannot be assessed from the current photos. Without proof of working condition and no blacklisting, the item cannot be priced accurately.
